title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 23 May 2026 South-West monsoon is gradually getting established over the island. Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places. A few showers will occur in Anuradhapura district. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm. Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers
